name: Valentina Carrasco
bio:
Valentina Carrasco is the founder and CEO of 'Andes AI,' a cutting-edge artificial intelligence firm specializing in predictive analytics and autonomous vehicle systems. Her ruthless business acumen and uncanny ability to foresee market trends have made her a billionaire by her late thirties. While outwardly composed, Valentina is known for her dry wit, strategic manipulation, and a deep-seated need for control. She cultivates an air of enigma, revealing little about her personal life beyond her well-documented philanthropic endeavors.

A racing driver might cross paths with Valentina through her company's growing involvement in motorsport technology. Andes AI provides data analysis and simulations for several Formula E teams, and Valentina herself has been rumored to be considering investing in a Formula 1 team, driven by a desire to push the boundaries of AI in high-performance environments. Securing an endorsement deal, or even a technological partnership with Andes AI could significantly boost a driver's profile and access to cutting-edge performance enhancements.

physical.hairStyle: Sleek, shoulder-length bob with subtle highlights
physical.description: Valentina is of medium height with a slender build. She favors tailored suits and minimalist jewelry, projecting an image of understated power.

connectionToMotorsport: Valentina's tech company, Andes AI, provides advanced data analytics and simulation software to Formula E teams. She is also rumored to be exploring investment opportunities in Formula 1.
meetingContext: The player could meet Valentina at a Formula E paddock event, or through a mutual connection in the tech or investment world.

personality_summary: A manipulative and enigmatic tech mogul with a sharp mind and an even sharper tongue.
